outcome_data.join: Exact symbol/trade_date join of CY-006 raw execution facts to the accepted coordinate state. coordinate_factor equals adjusted_close/raw close and coordinate OHLC equals raw OHLC times that factor. Missing joins fail closed.
outcome_data.scope: Only exact frozen candidate symbols and rows no later than 2020-12-31 may enter candidate-keyed paths. No 2021 or later row may be queried.

must_bind: this Stage-B freeze and completed Stage-B runner

outcome_attachment.signal_coordinate: Join each frozen candidate to the exact signal-date coordinate row; its global cal_idx and invalid_step_cum become the execution anchor.
outcome_attachment.entry: Inspect global market cal_idx signal+1 through signal+3 in order. Fill at the first legal, non-upper-limit coordinate open. A signal cannot fill on its own bar.
outcome_attachment.legal_row: Known trade_status=1, current_day_data_tradable, hard_valid raw row, valid/non-blocking corporate-action state, valid market rule, available_at no later than decision_at, and positive finite raw/coordinate prices and coordinate factor.
outcome_attachment.target: Before fallback eligibility, the first later same-lineage legal coordinate high at least 1.10 times entry exits at the exact target only when raw high and raw down-limit prove the bar was not locked down.
outcome_attachment.fallback: On the first same-lineage row with cal_idx strictly greater than entry_cal_idx+20, process the open before any same-day high. A sellable open at/above target fills at exact target; a sellable open below target exits immediately at coordinate open. Only an unsellable open may defer to a later same-day legal target touch.

outputs.publication: Same-parent temporary construction and atomic rename; refuse overwrite.

prohibited: running before CY-038 registration binds the completed runner
same-bar entry, entry after signal+3, or same-bar target
limit, suspension, corporate-action or coordinate-lineage relaxation
target, horizon, cost, threshold, market-state or portfolio search
overwriting an existing canonical Stage-B directory
